g.text: 17b · Account confirmation and initial session issuance
Submit account verification code(Email, 6-digit confirmation token)
Query pending account record and verification token hash
Token mismatch or expired verification record
Display invalid or expired code alert
Atomically update user status to ACTIVE and clear token
Generate initial access andrefresh token session pair
Persist new active refresh token session
Return confirmed tokens and user profile
Deliver authenticated session; redirect user to home feed
